text: Matthew has logged food on all 20 days of this attempt; Friday, September 25 was a good one — 182 g of protein, 1,761 calories, 106 g of it from one steak dinner. Over those 20 days he averages 153 g a day and cleared the 170 g floor on 7 of them. I've asked him to add one vegetable serving at lunch this week; Friday's fiber was 16.7 g. If blood-sugar advice cuts carbs, the calories go back in as protein or fat — at 1,577 a day he has no room below.
